name: Titanium.UI.Matrix3D
summary: The 3D Matrix is an object for holding values for a 3D affine transform.
description:
The 3D Matrix is created by [Titanium.UI.createMatrix3D](api:Titanium.UI#createMatrix3D). A 3D transform is
used to rotate, scale, translate, or skew the objects in three-dimensional
space. A 3D transform  is represented by a 4 by 4 matrix.

You create an `identity matrix` by creating a 3D Matrix with an empty
constructor.

methods.name: invert
methods.summary: Returns a matrix constructed by inverting this matrix.

methods.name: multiply
methods.summary: Returns a matrix constructed by combining two existing matrix.
methods.description:
The result of this function is the first matrix multiplied by the second matrix. You might perform
several multiplications in order to create a single matrix that contains the cumulative effects of
several transformations. Note that matrix operations are not commutative - the order in which
you concatenate matrices is important. That is, the result of multiplying matrix t1 by matrix t2
does not necessarily equal the result of multiplying matrix t2 by matrix t1.

parameters.name: t2
parameters.summary: Matrix to concatenate to this matrix.

methods.name: rotate
methods.summary: Returns a matrix constructed by rotating this matrix.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.summary: The angle, in degrees, by which to rotate the matrix. A positive value specifies counterclockwise rotation and a negative value specifies clockwise rotation.

parameters.name: x
parameters.summary: The x part of the vector about which to rotate.

parameters.name: y
parameters.summary: The y part of the vector about which to rotate.

parameters.name: z
parameters.summary: The z part of the vector about which to rotate.

parameters.name: sy

parameters.name: sz

methods.name: translate
